reason: A browser-side navigation panel that presents a minimap-like outline of the current chat, previews turn content on hover, and jumps to selected conversation turns.

summaries.zh: 为聊天界面添加侧边大纲栏，以可视化方式概览对话并支持预览和跳转到具体轮次。
summaries.en: Adds a browser-side conversation outline rail that provides a visual chat overview, hover previews, and navigation to specific turns.

capabilities: Reads the current conversation session and folded conversation nodes
Displays conversation-turn summaries in a side rail
Loads older conversation history for display
Scrolls the conversation to a selected user message
Tracks sidebar and window layout changes in the browser UI
